Belpahar English Medium School, Belpahar was established in 1968 with a vision to provide quality education rooted in Indian values and global outlook. Affiliated to the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE), New Delhi — offering ICSE (Class X) and ISC (Class XII) examinations — our school has been a beacon of academic excellence for over five decades.

Our school is committed to nurturing well-rounded individuals through a balanced curriculum that integrates academics, sports, arts, and moral education. We believe every child is unique and our dedicated faculty works tirelessly to unlock each student's potential.
Words of guidance from the Managing Director and the President as we shape the next generation at Belpahar English Medium School.
Dear Students, Parents, Teachers, and Well-Wishers,

It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to the website of our schools under the Belpahar Education Society Trust (BEST)—Belpahar English Medium School (BEMS), B. R. High School (BRHS), and Sunshine School (SSS). Together, these institutions play a vital role in shaping young minds and nurturing responsible citizens for the future.

Education today must go beyond academics. It should inspire curiosity, character, creativity, and a lifelong passion for learning. Our schools are committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and future-ready learning environment where every child is encouraged to discover and realise their true potential.

I am particularly proud of Programme PRAGATI (Platform for Reform, Accountability, Governance & Academic Transformation through Innovation), which is transforming our schools through modern technology, digital governance, enhanced transparency, and improved academic processes. Through integrated ERP systems, modern websites, mobile applications, and innovative learning initiatives, we are building a stronger foundation for educational excellence.

Our vision is to blend strong values with modern skills, ensuring that students are prepared not only for examinations but also for the challenges and opportunities of the 21st century. This journey is made possible by the dedication of our teachers, the trust of our parents, and the enthusiasm of our students.

I invite you to explore our website and witness the vibrant learning community that defines our schools. Together, let us continue to nurture excellence, innovation, and responsible citizenship for a brighter tomorrow.
TRL Krosaki Refractories Limited
Patron, Belpahar Education Society Trust (BEST)

It is with a deep sense of pride and responsibility that I greet you through this message on the official website of Belpahar English Medium School (lovingly known as “BEMS”). For decades, this institution has stood as a beacon of quality education in our region — shaping young minds, nurturing character, and building the foundation of countless successful lives. To serve as President of such a distinguished school is both a privilege and a profound responsibility, one that I embrace with sincerity and commitment.

We live in a world that is changing at an unprecedented pace. Technology is reshaping education, knowledge is being redefined, and the skills our children will need tomorrow are evolving today. In a world that is changing more swiftly than ever, the role of a school has grown not only greater in importance, but deeper in responsibility. At BEMS, we believe that true education must equip a child not only with knowledge, but with the values, resilience, creativity, and moral compass needed to navigate life with confidence and conviction.

Our vision is clear: to provide an environment where every student is encouraged to think independently, learn passionately, lead courageously, and live responsibly. We are committed to academic excellence, but equally to nurturing curiosity, empathy, integrity, and a strong sense of citizenship. Through a balanced focus on academics, sports, arts, life skills, and character building, we strive to develop well-rounded individuals — students who excel not just in classrooms and careers, but as human beings.

I am especially proud of the dedication of our teachers, whose passion and commitment are the true strength of our school. I am grateful to our parents for their trust, partnership, and active support — for an education of this kind is only possible when the school and the family walk together. And to our students — you are at the centre of everything we do. Your dreams inspire us; your growth is our greatest reward.

As we look to the future, our endeavour is to continue strengthening our infrastructure, modernising our learning environment, embracing digital and experiential pedagogy, and empowering our teachers with the best of training and tools. We will do all this while staying firmly rooted in the values, discipline, and culture that have always defined BEMS.

I warmly invite you to explore our website to discover more about our school — our history, our people, our programmes, and the vibrant life of our campus. Whether you are a visitor to our website, a parent considering BEMS for your child, an alumnus revisiting fond memories, a well-wisher, or a member of our extended family, you will always find a warm welcome here.
Together, let us continue to build a School (BEMS of GEMS) that our children deserve — and a future they will be proud to lead.
Kumar Heramba Narayan Naik
Dear parents, students, and well-wishers

Welcome to our school website. Education is not merely the acquisition of knowledge, but the holistic development of a child’s personality — intellectual, emotional, moral, and social. We strive to create a nurturing environment where every child feels valued, inspired, and confident to explore their true potential.

We are committed to academic excellence while fostering creativity, critical thinking, discipline, and strong ethical values. Our faculty ensures that learning stays engaging, meaningful, and future-oriented, with equal emphasis on co-curricular activities, sports, and life skills so students grow into responsible, compassionate, and self-reliant citizens.

In a rapidly changing world, we aim to equip learners with adaptability, resilience, and a lifelong love for learning. The partnership between parents and teachers remains vital in shaping young minds, and we deeply value it.
We invite you to explore our vision, values, and achievements on this site.
Comprehensive CISCE-aligned curriculum (ICSE & ISC) designed to foster intellectual growth, creativity, and practical skills from Nursery to Class XII.
Ages 3-5 | Play-based Learning

Our Pre-Primary wing follows a child-centric approach with emphasis on learning through play, exploration, and creative activities. The curriculum is designed to develop foundational skills in language, numeracy, motor skills, and social-emotional learning.
Ages 6-10 | Building Strong Foundations

The Primary wing focuses on building strong foundations in core subjects â English, Hindi, Mathematics, EVS, and Computer Science. Experiential learning, project work, and co-curricular activities ensure holistic development.
Ages 11-13 | Exploring & Expanding

The Middle wing introduces students to Science, Social Science, and Sanskrit as additional subjects. Laboratory work, field trips, and inter-school competitions help students explore their interests and develop critical thinking.
Ages 14-15 | ICSE (Class X) preparation

The Secondary wing prepares students for the ICSE (Class X) examination with rigorous academic training, regular assessments, remedial classes, and focused board exam preparation. Students choose between Hindi and Sanskrit as second language.
Ages 16-17 | Specialized Streams

We offer three streams â Science (PCM/PCB), Commerce, and Humanities â with experienced subject specialists. The focus is on ISC (Class XII) excellence along with competitive exam preparation (JEE, NEET, CUET).
